Name: Mutant Rings (X-Men) - Ring Expansion
Author: ApryllForever
Description:
[center][color=#ff00ff][size=6]
Rings:[/size][/color][/center]
[color=#ff00ff]Dark Phoenix Ring (Jean Grey):[/color]
﻿- Revival 1x/Day
﻿- Revenge Explosion around player on Revival
﻿- Glows
﻿- When killing a monster, creates an explosion in the area
﻿- Increases attack, knockback, defense, and immunity


[color=#00ff00]Rogue Ring (Anna Marie Lebeau):[/color]
﻿- On killing enemy, health + 17, energy + 13
﻿- On killing enemy, there may be additional loot
﻿- Much stronger attack and defense values, with also immunity


[color=#00ffff]Mystique Ring (Raven Darkholme):[/color]
﻿- When receiving damage, heals for 3-13 hitpoints
﻿- increases attack, luck, and speed
﻿- Kills mummies without need for bombs or crusader enchantments

[color=#ff0000]Goblin Queen Ring (Madelyne Pryor):[/color]
﻿﻿- Revival 1x/Day
﻿- Revenge Explosion around player on Revival
﻿- Glows red (a little)
﻿- Dramatically increases attack and critical chance

[color=#00ffff]White Queen Ring (Emma Frost):[/color]
﻿- When killing enemy, there is a 1/20 chance for a diamond to appear
﻿- Kills all bugs without need for an enchantment
﻿- Increases attack, dramatically increases defense and immunity, and also, increases critical chance

[color=#00ffff]Storm Ring (Ororo Munroe):[/color]
﻿- Every three seconds, a lightning blast automatically attacks nearby enemies, damage amount scales with combat level
﻿- On taking damage, an additional protective lightning blast attacks an enemy, damage amount scales with combat level
﻿- Increases attack, critical chance, and knockback

[color=#ffff00]Shadow Cat Ring (Kitty Pride):[/color]
﻿- Become invincible for four seconds after taking damage
﻿- Increases attack, critical chance, and knockback
﻿
[size=6][color=#ff0000]D[/color][color=#ff7700]a[/color][color=#ffff00]z[/color][color=#00ff00]z[/color][color=#00ffff]l[/color][color=#0000ff]e[/color][color=#9900ff]r[/color][/size] Ring (Alison Blaire):
﻿- Creates a Rainbow Attack when attacked, scales to combat level
﻿- Increases attack and knockback

[color=#ff0000]Magma Ring (Amara Aquilla):[/color]
﻿- Creates a Flame Attack when attacked, scales to combat level
﻿﻿- Increases attack, critical chance, and knockback

[color=#ff0000]Scarlet Witch Ring (Wanda Maximoff):[/color]
- ﻿Every three seconds, fires a projectile attacking the nearest enemy, damage amount scales with combat level
﻿- Creates an explosion when attacked, scales to combat level
﻿- When worn, a red chaos fog appears
﻿- Increases attack and speed
﻿- +3 luck

[color=#00ffff]Jubilee Ring (Jubilation Lee):[/color]
﻿- When attacked, counter attacks with fireworks,  amount scales with combat level
﻿- Increases defense and knockback

[color=#ff7700]Wolverine Ring (Logan):[/color]
﻿- Heals every six seconds  (roughly 3 times for each in game 20 minutes)
﻿- Increase of attack, defense, and immunity

[color=#ff0000]Magneto Ring (Eric Lensher):[/color]
﻿﻿- Creates an explosion when attacked, scales to combat level
﻿- On killing various monsters, gives various metal ores or else metal bars
﻿- Extreme increase of magnetic radius
﻿- Dramatic increase of knockback and attack


NOTE:

The Mystique Ring has a speed config. You may set any number. But, you must set it while the ring is off your finger. Might take a few equips and re-equips to reset when changing numbers. Cheers loves!
